high_level_description: stc brand style, an aerial photograph of eroded sandstone canyon formations.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A desert landscape of layered, weathered beige and light brown rock formations with natural pillars and crevices, viewed from a high angle in natural even lighting.

elements.desc: Multiple levels of eroded sandstone rock formations creating a natural canyon-like structure, with small crevices and shadows throughout.
